title.zh: 从先序遍历还原二叉树
title.en: Recover a Tree From Preorder Traversal

desc.zh: 从短横线深度推导祖先路径，逐步还原父子关系。
desc.en: Derive an ancestor path from dash depths and rebuild every parent link.

complexity: O(L) time; O(h) auxiliary space plus O(n) returned tree, where L is traversal length and h is path height in nodes

concepts.name: depth-marked preorder reconstruction
concepts.description: Read depth/value tokens and use the only-left-child guarantee.

concepts.name: ancestor path stack
concepts.description: Pop closed subtrees to expose the unique parent at depth minus one.
